newsitem.title: USA: Belco Oil to produce dual-lateral well.
newsitem.headline: Belco Oil to produce dual-lateral well.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Tuesday it had successfully tested the second lateral on its Turner 22 No. 1 well in St. Landry Parish, La., and expects to begin producing the well this week.

On initial test, the second, downdip lateral flowed from the Austin Chalk formation at the rate of 2,700 barrels of oil and 9.3 million cubic feet of natural gas per day at a flowing tubing pressure of 4,600 pounds per square inch on a 30/64 inch choke. This dual lateral well was drilled to a vertical depth of 16,700 feet with the downdip and updip laterals drilled horizontally for 2,400 and 2,700 feet respectively.

The company previously said initial test rates for the first lateral produced 5,100 barrels of oil and 17 million cubic feet of gas per day at a flowing tubing pressure of 4,100 pounds per square inch on a 48/64 inch choke.
Belco said it has a 100 percent working interest in this well until payout and a 77-1/2 percent working interest thereafter.
The company said it expects to place the downdip lateral on production in the next few days and will eventually combine production from both laterals.
